chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Jaʿfar, from Ibrāhīm ibn Mahziyār, from Faḍālah ibn Ayyūb, from al-Qāsim ibn Burayd, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
The ghusl of the deceased is like the ghusl of the junub, and if he has abundant hair, then pour extra water over him three times.

key_terms.الْجُنُبِ: a person in the state of janabah requiring ghusl

ai.seo_question: How should the ghusl of a deceased person be performed according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the ghusl of the deceased, stating that it is to be performed like the ghusl of a person in janabah. It also instructs that if the deceased has abundant hair, extra water should be poured over him three times.
